sources.scope: Phase 10 derivative and Simpson integration prompts, polynomial and guide results, repeat and n=0 error recovery.

notes: Native frames are independent evidence; intermediate golden frames are implementation regression assertions.
Native guide derivative displays 0.577350268; application sample arithmetic displays 0.57735027. Exact private arithmetic remains a known precision gap.
The guide integral print and native display both read 0.785357562; an earlier OCR misreading is discarded.

2026-10-08 resolution: operation truncation at 13 significant digits and final-sample truncation at 14 reproduce both native derivative displays. Earlier application observations above remain historical evidence. Complete private-arithmetic parity is not asserted.
